claim: The GuardDuty quota for member accounts associated with an administrator account through AWS Organizations is 50,000, including member accounts added to the organization by invitation; this default value depends on your current AWS Organizations member account quota and can't exceed the number of member accounts in your organization. The maximum was raised to 50,000 on December 20, 2023; from June 29, 2023 it was 10,000.

qualifiers.scope: per GuardDuty administrator account, through AWS Organizations
qualifiers.condition: the default value depends on your current quota for member accounts in AWS Organizations
